filed: 2026-11-13, before any run; never edited after a run (add a dated report instead)

measurement.share: E57's re-gating share (K00 - K01) / (K00 - K11), cells summed over a row set's 128 rows of 256 tokens, status by commute.qwen_reading.shares, on the frozen-neuron decomposition p-015e0710 (subcomponents fixed at the MLP neurons, only Gamma trained, MLP matrices only), as P3.9 (E179) read it
measurement.size: K00: mean KL per position over the 128 rows between the changed model and the original subcomponents under W0's masks. The size axis for built changes, random changes and P3.9's fine-tunes (run2 .means.K00) alike. Searched on the first 32 rows as K00 - K0 (the change's size above W0's own masked error) to within 1.05x; a read is 'matched' when its 128-row K00 is within 1.1x of its target. Why 32 rows: in P3.9's records the 32-row K00 is within 4.2% of the 128-row one (16 rows: 5.5%), so 1.05 x 1.042 < 1.1
measurement.sizes: Per row set, from P3.9 run2's fine-tunes on it (6 states; 12 on gold rows: gold and gold_shuf): low = their lowest K00, high = their highest, mid = sqrt(low x high). Built changes at mid; random draws at all three
measurement.built_change: A set of MLP neurons switched off by zeroing their gate_proj rows: dW = -W0 on those rows, zero elsewhere (silu(0) = 0, so the neuron's output is 0 whatever up_proj gives). Each neuron is one subcomponent of p-015e0710, so the change is exactly a mask of 0 on it. The used pool, per layer: the top 10% of the live gate neurons by mean |a| on the row set's 128 rows at W0, positions 1-255 (a = down_proj's input; position 0, where attention-sink activations sit, left out). Three orders of the pool, each interleaved over the 28 layers (every layer's first, then every layer's second, ...): top (most used first), random (seeded random order), specific (highest ratio of mean |a| on this row set to the mean over the other four first). The change is the first k of an order, k searched (from 28, at most the pool) so K00 lands at mid
measurement.random_change: iid Gaussian on the 84 MLP matrices (seed null_seed(d, site), draws d = 0, 1, 2), each matrix at the per-matrix norm of the row set's seed-0 late fine-tune (P3.9 run1 <rowset>_s0_last_kl.json .random.norms), times one scale b searched per size so K00 lands at low, mid and high. Draw 0 is P3.9 run 1's direction for that state
measurement.curve: Per row set, per size level with at least two usable draws (scored and matched): the point (geometric mean K00, mean share); the curve is linear in log K00 between levels, and a K00 outside the span by at most 1.1x takes the nearest end's share (commute.share_reading.curve, at)
measurement.band: Per row set: the largest distance of a usable random draw's share from the curve at its own K00 (share_reading.band). Measured in this job, not guessed
measurement.placement: A reading's gap = its share minus the curve at its own K00: 'above' if gap > band, 'below' if gap < -band, 'inside' otherwise (rounded to 9 places, a gap equal to the band is inside); 'unreadable' if the reading is not usable (not scored, or for a built change not matched), its share is not finite, the curve has no value at its K00 or there is no band (share_reading.place)
measurement.blind_to: The share reads only how much of the change's output effect the original neurons recover under Gamma's masks on the changed model's forward; it cannot tell which neurons moved. The built change tests switching neurons off only; switching on (masks are 0 to 1) cannot be built this way. Attention matrices are not decomposed in p-015e0710 and are left unchanged by every change here
measurement.positive_control: The built change is the share's positive control: a change that is a switching-off by construction. The do-nothing state (share 1 by construction) checks the split path only
measurement.noise_floor: The band, from three random draws per size on each row set in this job. For the card: P3.9 run2's seed sd of a fine-tune's share, largest 0.0063, pooled 0.0030

controls_stop_on_miss.W0: Stage 0, first and alone, per row set on its first 16 rows: W0 as the changed model, K00 and K01 equal K0, an all-zero split's K10 and K11 equal K0, each within 1e-6 relative
controls_stop_on_miss.do_nothing: Stage 0: the do-nothing state of random draw 0 at scale 100 on the first row set's 16 rows through the split path: share within 1e-6 of 1
controls_stop_on_miss.K0_floor: Every read: its mean K0 over 128 rows equals experiments/qwen_library_share/results/p-015e0710/floors.json .floors.<rowset>.K0 within 1e-3 relative (it is W0's number, so this checks the rows)
controls_stop_on_miss.alive: The Lab stops unless the live set rebuilt from p-015e0710's W0 g statistics counts 516,092 (ALIVE_TOTAL_OF)
controls_stop_on_miss.stored_error: As P3.9: each split's fp32 X within 1e-3 of float64, in ||dW||_Sigma
controls_stop_on_miss.gpu: As P3.9: peak under 44 GiB after the first row of each cell pass

expected.W0: Holds; K0 per row set on 16 rows about 0.13-0.23 (P3.9 run2 pod logs: known 0.1325, invented 0.2301)
expected.K0_floor: Holds on every read (P3.9's reads of the same rows matched within 2e-4)
expected.random_scale: b between 30 and 3000 (P3.9 run 1 matched 16-row unmasked KL with b 44-640 at the same norms)
expected.random_share: Each draw 'scored'; share between about 0.80 and 1.06 (P3.9 run 1: 0.81-1.06), falling as K00 grows
expected.built_k: Not predicted (no measurement of one neuron's effect here); logged by the search. A 'top' set may overshoot mid at k = 1 if a massive-activation neuron leads its order: that read is unmatched and unreadable, and is reported as such
expected.built_share: Rival A: near 1 (at least the curve plus the band); rival B: on the curve within the band
expected.time: About 3.5 h on one H100 NVL: stage 0 about 3 min; usage about 2 min; per built change about 4 min (search about 5 x 20 s, split 45 s, read 115 s); per random draw about 8 min (one split, three searches of about 3 x 15 s, three reads)

rules.built: share_reading.outcome over the 15 built reads (5 row sets x 3 choices), min readable 9, fraction 0.8: 'above random' (rival A) if at least 80% of the readable reads are 'above'; 'like random' (rival B) if at least 80% are 'inside'; 'below random' if at least 80% are 'below'; 'mixed' otherwise; 'unreadable' under 9 readable. Counts per choice are reported beside it, not scored
rules.finetunes: share_reading.outcome over P3.9's 36 read fine-tunes (6 arms x seeds 0-2 x saves 5x, last), each placed on its own row set's curve at its own K00, min readable 27, fraction 0.8: 'above random', 'like random', 'below random', 'mixed' or 'unreadable'. A description: no reuse or new label follows from it

edge_cases_checked: Run on CPU 2026-11-13 before filing, tests/test_share_reading.py (11 passed)

edge_cases.curve: a level with one usable draw, or: level dropped; under two levels no curve and no band

do_nothing_against_the_rule: The do-nothing state reads share 1 by construction and would place 'above' any curve under 1. It is the split path's control, never a candidate: the built change and the random draws are read through the same least-squares split, so only Gamma's masks on the changed model (K01) separate them

leans.written_before_running: Lean to rival A, weakly: Gamma's readout at the down_proj site reads each neuron's actual activation, which is 0 for a zeroed gate row. Against it, the gate and up sites' readouts read x V with the original V, unchanged by the zeroing
